title: Assess Safety and Efficacy of Lacosamide in Patients With Partial Seizures
brief_summary: The main purpose of this trial is to determine safety and efficacy of Lacosamide under long term therapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of Epilepsy
* completion of double blind trial

Exclusion Criteria:

* taking other investigational drug than Lacosamide
* meeting withdrawal criteria from double blind trial
